dedupe_keys.name: modpowersystems modelica library of phasor and electromagnetic transient power system models

description: ModPowerSystems is a Modelica package of power system models from the Institute for Automation of Complex Power Systems at the E.ON Energy Research Center, RWTH Aachen University. The FEIN Aachen project page says it includes models built with static phasors, dynamic phasors and electromagnetic transient variables, and that the library is being published step by step, starting from basic circuit components towards typical power system components. The page lists publications that use it, among them a co-simulation architecture for power system, communication and market in the smart grid, and hosting capacity improvement with control of photovoltaic and battery storage systems. Coverage: component models for any grid assembled in Modelica. Format and access: a public GitHub repository (ModPowerSystems/ModPowerSystems), which returned an error to the cloud, so its contents were not read. Licence: Modelica License 2 (G-PST Open Tools Portal). Caveats: activity dates and the list of released components were not read; questions go through the FEIN Aachen Slack channel. Simulation uses: multi-level power system simulations from phasor to electromagnetic transient detail, including co-simulation with communication and market models. Related records: SSMD (model-ssmd-state-space-linear-distribution-grid), from the same institute, models distribution grids in MATLAB.
